# Proko

> Proko is a comprehensive online learning platform for drawing and character design, offering video tutorials from industry professionals.

Founded by Stan Prokopenko, Proko provides structured art courses covering figure drawing, portrait drawing, anatomy, perspective, digital painting, and character design. The platform features instruction from renowned artists including Dave Greco, Michael Hampton, Marshall Vandruff, Eliza Ivanova, and David Finch, with content ranging from drawing fundamentals to advanced character concept art.

## Core Learning Hub

- [Proko - Learn How to Draw with Fun Tutorials](https://static.proko.com/static/): Proko's homepage offering drawing tutorials for figures, faces, and portraits
- [Proko - Browse Lessons](https://static.proko.com/static/browse/all): Course catalog and lesson browser for all drawing and art fundamentals
